# Fyniq API

> Fyniq's public REST API (/v1) for the accounting, compliance and reporting of a Singapore company. The web app uses only this API. AI agents and MCP clients read through it and may only propose changes, which a named person approves in the web app; they never approve, pay, file or administer anything.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code and a fix. Writes take an Idempotency-Key and Prefer: return=preview; versioned records need If-Match; lists are cursor-paginated; money is a decimal string with its currency, never a JSON number.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/docs/api/agent-guide.md): how to read, how to propose, and what is never allowed
- [API reference](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/docs/api/reference.md): every operation with its permission, parameters, bodies and error codes
- [OpenAPI contract](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/contracts/openapi/fyniq.v1.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1, exactly as the API serves it at /v1/openapi.json
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/contracts/schemas/): one per resource (JSON Schema 2020-12)

## Operations

- `GET /v1/access-review` (getAccessReview): Read the user access review
- `POST /v1/access-review/attestations` (attestAccessReview): Attest the user access review for a quarter
- `GET /v1/access-review/export` (exportAccessReview): Export the user access review
- `GET /v1/accountant-reviews` (listAccountantReviews): List the accountant's reviews
- `GET /v1/accountant-reviews/{review_id}` (getAccountantReview): Get an accountant's review
- `POST /v1/accountant-reviews/{review_id}/journals` (linkAccountantReviewJournal): Link an adjusting journal to a review
- `POST /v1/accountant-reviews/{review_id}/queries` (askAccountantReviewQuery): Raise a query in a review
- `POST /v1/accountant-reviews/{review_id}/queries/{query_id}/answer` (answerAccountantReviewQuery): Answer a review's query
- `POST /v1/accountant-reviews/{review_id}/sign-off` (signOffAccountantReview): Sign off a review
- `GET /v1/accounts` (listAccounts): List the chart of accounts
- `POST /v1/accounts` (createAccount): Add an account
- `GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}` (getAccount): Get an account
- `PATCH /v1/accounts/{account_id}` (updateAccount): Change an account
- `POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/merge-approval` (requestAccountMerge): Ask for approval to merge an account into another
- `POST /v1/accounts:load-standard-chart` (loadStandardChart): Load the standard chart of accounts
- `GET /v1/acra-extracts` (listAcraExtracts): List the ACRA register extracts
- `POST /v1/acra-extracts` (createAcraExtract): Type in an ACRA register extract
- `GET /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}` (getAcraExtract): Get an ACRA register extract
- `PUT /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}` (replaceAcraExtract): Change a drafted ACRA register extract
- `GET /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}/evidence` (listAcraExtractEvidence): List an ACRA extract's files
- `POST /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}/evidence` (addAcraExtractEvidence): Attach the business profile an ACRA extract was typed from
- `GET /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getAcraExtractEvidence): Get an ACRA extract's file
- `DELETE /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeAcraExtractEvidence): Remove a file from a drafted ACRA extract
- `POST /v1/acra-extracts/{extract_id}/record` (recordAcraExtract): Record an ACRA register extract
- `GET /v1/announcements` (listAnnouncements): List the organisation's announcements
- `POST /v1/announcements` (publishAnnouncement): Publish a banner to the organisation
- `POST /v1/announcements/{announcement_id}/withdraw` (withdrawAnnouncement): Withdraw an announcement
- `GET /v1/approval-policies` (listApprovalPolicies): List the approval policies
- `GET /v1/approval-policies/{object_type}` (getApprovalPolicy): Get an approval policy
- `PATCH /v1/approval-policies/{object_type}` (changeApprovalPolicy): Ask to change an approval policy
- `GET /v1/approvals` (listApprovals): List the approval requests
- `GET /v1/approvals/{approval_id}` (getApproval): Get an approval request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/approve` (approveApproval): Approve a request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/challenge` (challengeApproval): Start signing a request with a passkey
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/reject` (rejectApproval): Reject a request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/withdraw` (withdrawApproval): Withdraw your request
- `GET /v1/asset-disposals` (listAssetDisposals): List disposals of fixed assets
- `GET /v1/asset-disposals/{disposal_id}` (getAssetDisposal): Get a disposal of a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/asset-disposals/{disposal_id}/void` (voidAssetDisposal): Void a disposal of a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/asset-disposals/{disposal_id}/void-approval` (requestAssetDisposalVoid): Ask for approval to void a disposal of a fixed asset
- `GET /v1/audit/events` (listAuditEvents): List the audit trail's events
- `GET /v1/audit/events/{event_id}` (getAuditEvent): Get an audit event
- `POST /v1/audit/exports` (requestAuditTrailExport): Ask for the audit trail's export
- `GET /v1/audit/purges` (listAuditPurges): List the purges after retention
- `GET /v1/audit/recoveries` (listAuditRecoveries): List the audit trail's recoveries from restores behind its anchors
- `POST /v1/audit/recoveries/{recovery_id}/acknowledge` (acknowledgeAuditRecovery): Acknowledge a recovery of the audit trail
- `GET /v1/audit/verification` (getAuditVerification): Verify the audit trail's integrity for a range of days
- `GET /v1/auto-reconciliations` (listAutoReconciliations): List what the system reconciled
- `POST /v1/bank-changes` (createPayeeBankChange): Prepare a change of a vendor's bank details
- `GET /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}` (getPayeeBankChange): Get a change of a vendor's bank details
- `PUT /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}` (replacePayeeBankChange): Change a draft change of bank details
- `POST /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/approval` (requestPayeeBankChangeApproval): Ask for approval of a change of bank details
- `GET /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (listPayeeBankChangeEvidence): List a change's evidence
- `POST /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (addPayeeBankChangeEvidence): Attach evidence to a change of bank details
- `GET /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getPayeeBankChangeEvidence): Get a change's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removePayeeBankChangeEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft change of bank details
- `POST /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/reveal` (revealPayeeBankAccount): Reveal an account's full number
- `POST /v1/bank-imports` (importBankStatements): Import bank statements
- `GET /v1/bank-lines` (listBankLines): List bank lines
- `GET /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}` (getBankLine): Get a bank line
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/categorise` (categoriseBankLine): Categorise a bank line
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/exclude` (excludeBankLine): Exclude a bank line
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/keep` (keepBankLine): Keep a possible duplicate
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/match-bills` (matchBankLineBills): Match money out to bills
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/match-invoices` (matchBankLineInvoices): Match money in to invoices
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/match-recorded` (matchBankLineRecorded): Match a bank line to money recorded by hand
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/suspend` (suspendBankLine): Put a bank line in suspense
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/unreconcile` (unreconcileBankLine): Put a bank line back in the queue
- `POST /v1/bank-lines:auto-reconcile` (autoReconcileBankLines): Reconcile now
- `GET /v1/bank-reconciliations` (listBankReconciliations): List a period's reconciliations
- `POST /v1/bank-reconciliations` (prepareBankReconciliation): Prepare a money account's reconciliation
- `GET /v1/bank-rule-offers` (listBankRuleOffers): List the rules offered from repeated codings
- `GET /v1/bank-rules` (listBankRules): List the bank rules
- `POST /v1/bank-rules` (createBankRule): Create a bank rule
- `GET /v1/bank-rules/{rule_id}` (getBankRule): Get a bank rule
- `PUT /v1/bank-rules/{rule_id}` (replaceBankRule): Change a bank rule
- `POST /v1/bank-rules/{rule_id}/auto-apply-approval` (requestBankRuleAutoApply): Ask for approval to let a bank rule apply by itself
- `POST /v1/bank-rules:back-test` (backTestBankRule): Back-test bank rule conditions
- `GET /v1/bank-signals` (listBankSignals): List the incoming-funds signals
- `POST /v1/bank-signals/{signal_id}/dismiss` (dismissBankSignal): Dismiss an incoming-funds signal
- `GET /v1/bank-transfers` (listBankTransfers): List the transfers in transit
- `POST /v1/bank-transfers` (recordBankTransfer): Record a transfer between money accounts
- `GET /v1/bank-transfers/{transfer_id}` (getBankTransfer): Get a transfer
- `POST /v1/bank-transfers/{transfer_id}/complete` (completeBankTransfer): Complete a transfer in transit
- `POST /v1/bank-transfers/{transfer_id}/undo` (undoBankTransfer): Undo a transfer
- `GET /v1/banners` (listBanners): List the banners you see now
- `POST /v1/banners/{announcement_id}/dismiss` (dismissBanner): Dismiss a banner
- `GET /v1/bill-payments` (listBillPayments): List the payments of bills
- `POST /v1/bill-payments` (recordBillPayment): Record a payment of bills
- `GET /v1/bill-payments/{payment_id}` (getBillPayment): Get a payment of bills
- `POST /v1/bill-payments/{payment_id}/void` (voidBillPayment): Void a payment of bills
- `POST /v1/bill-payments/{payment_id}/void-approval` (requestBillPaymentVoid): Ask for approval to void a payment of bills
- `GET /v1/bill-reminders` (listBillReminders): List the bills to pay soon
- `GET /v1/bills` (listBills): List the bills
- `POST /v1/bills` (createBill): Save a draft bill
- `GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}` (getBill): Get a bill
- `PUT /v1/bills/{bill_id}` (replaceBill): Change a draft bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/edit` (editBill): Edit a posted bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/edit-approval` (requestBillEdit): Ask for approval to edit a posted bill
- `GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence` (listBillEvidence): List a bill's evidence
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence` (addBillEvidence): Attach evidence to a bill
- `GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getBillEvidence): Get a bill's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeBillEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/payment-plan` (planBillPayment): Plan a bill's payment date
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/post` (postBill): Post a draft bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/post-approval` (requestBillPost): Ask for approval to post a bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/void` (voidBill): Void a posted bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/void-approval` (requestBillVoid): Ask for approval to void a bill
- `GET /v1/break-glass` (listBreakGlass): List the break-glasses
- `POST /v1/break-glass` (startBreakGlass): Start break-glass
- `GET /v1/break-glass/{break_glass_id}` (getBreakGlass): Get a break-glass
- `POST /v1/break-glass/{break_glass_id}/end` (endBreakGlass): End break-glass now
- `POST /v1/break-glass/{break_glass_id}/review` (reviewBreakGlass): Review a break-glass
- `GET /v1/budgets` (listBudgets): List the budgets
- `POST /v1/budgets` (createBudget): Draft a budget
- `GET /v1/budgets/{budget_id}` (getBudget): Get a budget
- `PUT /v1/budgets/{budget_id}` (replaceBudget): Change a drafted budget
- `POST /v1/budgets/{budget_id}/approval` (requestBudgetApproval): Ask for approval of a budget
- `POST /v1/budgets:copy` (copyBudget): Copy a budget with growth
- `POST /v1/budgets:import` (importBudget): Import a budget from XLSX
- `GET /v1/cap-table` (getCapTable): Get the cap table
- `GET /v1/cap-table/acra-reconciliation` (getAcraReconciliation): Get the register against ACRA's
- `GET /v1/cap-table/export` (exportCapTable): Export the cap table
- `GET /v1/cap-table/statutory-tests` (getStatutoryTests): Get the cap table's statutory tests
- `GET /v1/card-lines` (listCardLines): List the lines of your company cards
- `POST /v1/card-lines/{line_id}/complete` (completeCardLine): Complete a line of your company card
- `GET /v1/card-lines/{line_id}/evidence` (listCardLineEvidence): List the receipts of a line of your company card
- `POST /v1/card-lines/{line_id}/evidence` (addCardLineEvidence): Attach the receipt of a line of your company card
- `GET /v1/cash-advances` (listCashAdvances): List cash advances and their refunds
- `POST /v1/cash-advances` (recordCashAdvance): Record a cash advance to a member
- `GET /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}` (getCashAdvance): Get a cash advance or its refund
- `POST /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}/refunds` (recordCashAdvanceRefund): Record the refund of what is left of a cash advance
- `POST /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}/void` (voidCashAdvance): Void a cash advance or its refund
- `POST /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}/void-approval` (requestCashAdvanceVoid): Ask for approval to void a cash advance or its refund
- `GET /v1/cash-position` (getCashPosition): Get the cash position
- `GET /v1/cash-projection` (getCashProjection): Get the short-term cash flow
- `POST /v1/cash-projection:what-if` (whatIfCashProjection): Ask a what-if of the short-term cash flow
- `GET /v1/checks` (listChecks): List the checks and books health
- `POST /v1/checks/runs` (runChecks): Run every check now
- `GET /v1/checks/{key}` (getCheck): Get a check
- `PUT /v1/checks/{key}/owner` (setCheckOwner): Name a check's owner
- `POST /v1/checks/{key}/reviews` (reviewCheckItem): Mark an item to review as reviewed
- `GET /v1/claim-categories` (listClaimCategories): List the expense policy's categories
- `POST /v1/claim-categories` (createClaimCategory): Add a category to the expense policy
- `PUT /v1/claim-categories/{category_id}` (replaceClaimCategory): Change a category of the expense policy
- `POST /v1/claim-categories:load-starter` (loadStarterClaimCategories): Load the starter categories
- `GET /v1/claim-places` (listClaimPlaces): List your saved places
- `POST /v1/claim-places` (createClaimPlace): Save a place for your trips
- `PUT /v1/claim-places/{place_id}` (replaceClaimPlace): Change one of your saved places
- `GET /v1/claim-reimbursements` (listClaimReimbursements): List reimbursements of expense claims
- `POST /v1/claim-reimbursements` (recordClaimReimbursement): Record a reimbursement of expense claims
- `GET /v1/claim-reimbursements/{reimbursement_id}` (getClaimReimbursement): Get a reimbursement of expense claims
- `POST /v1/claim-reimbursements/{reimbursement_id}/void` (voidClaimReimbursement): Void a reimbursement of expense claims
- `POST /v1/claim-reimbursements/{reimbursement_id}/void-approval` (requestClaimReimbursementVoid): Ask for approval to void a reimbursement of expense claims
- `GET /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}` (getClaimantBankChange): Get a change of a person's bank account
- `GET /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (listClaimantBankChangeEvidence): List a change of a person's bank account's evidence
- `GET /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getClaimantBankChangeEvidence): Get a change of a person's bank account's evidence file

- `GET /v1/compliance/anonymisations` (listAnonymisations): List the anonymised contacts

- `POST /v1/compliance/breaches` (recordBreach): Record a personal-data breach

- `GET /v1/compliance/consent-purposes` (listConsentPurposes): List the consent purposes
- `POST /v1/compliance/consent-purposes` (createConsentPurpose): Add a consent purpose

- `POST /v1/compliance/consents` (recordConsent): Record a consent given or withdrawn

- `GET /v1/compliance/controls/{control_id}` (getControl): Get a control and its status
- `GET /v1/compliance/data-inventory` (getDataInventory): Get the personal-data inventory and retention schedule

- `PUT /v1/compliance/data-inventory/entries/{entry_id}` (reviseDataInventoryEntry): Change an entry of the personal-data inventory

- `DELETE /v1/session/passkeys/{passkey_id}` (revokePasskey): Revoke a passkey
- `POST /v1/session/recovery` (recoverAccount): Recover your account
- `GET /v1/session/recovery-codes` (getMyRecoveryCodes): Say whether you keep recovery codes
- `POST /v1/session/recovery-codes` (replaceMyRecoveryCodes): Make your recovery codes
- `POST /v1/session/step-up` (stepUp): Confirm it's you with a passkey
- `POST /v1/session/step-up/challenge` (startStepUp): Start confirming it's you with a passkey
- `GET /v1/setup` (getSetupStatus): Get the setup status
- `POST /v1/setup` (completeSetup): Complete first-run setup
- `GET /v1/share-classes` (listShareClasses): List the share classes
- `POST /v1/share-classes` (createShareClass): Draft a share class
- `GET /v1/share-classes/{version_id}` (getShareClass): Get a share class version
- `PUT /v1/share-classes/{version_id}` (replaceShareClass): Change a drafted share class version
- `POST /v1/share-classes/{version_id}/approval` (requestShareClassApproval): Ask for approval to record a share class
- `GET /v1/share-classes/{version_id}/evidence` (listShareClassEvidence): List a share class version's files
- `POST /v1/share-classes/{version_id}/evidence` (addShareClassEvidence): Attach a share class's documents
- `GET /v1/share-classes/{version_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getShareClassEvidence): Get a share class version's file
- `DELETE /v1/share-classes/{version_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeShareClassEvidence): Remove a file from a drafted share class version
- `GET /v1/share-issues` (listShareIssues): List the register of share issues
- `POST /v1/share-issues` (recordShareIssueBeforeBooks): Record shares issued before the books start
- `GET /v1/sign-in-providers` (listSignInProviders): List the sign-in providers
- `GET /v1/statement-mappings` (listStatementMappings): List the saved column mappings
- `POST /v1/statement-mappings` (createStatementMapping): Save a column mapping
- `PUT /v1/statement-mappings/{mapping_id}` (replaceStatementMapping): Change a column mapping
- `GET /v1/statements` (listStatements): List the statements made
- `POST /v1/statements` (createStatement): Make a statement to send
- `GET /v1/statements/{statement_id}` (getStatement): Get a statement made
- `POST /v1/statements/{statement_id}/email` (emailStatement): Email a statement to the customer
- `GET /v1/statutory-packs` (listStatutoryPacks): List the statutory pack versions
- `GET /v1/statutory-packs/{version_id}` (getStatutoryPack): Get a statutory pack version
- `POST /v1/statutory-packs/{version_id}/activate` (activateStatutoryPack): Ask to activate a statutory pack version
- `POST /v1/super-admins` (acceptSuperAdminInvitation): Become a Super admin with an invitation
- `POST /v1/super-admins/invitations` (createSuperAdminInvitation): Invite the second Super admin
- `POST /v1/super-admins/recovery` (recoverSuperAdmin): Recover your Super admin access
- `POST /v1/super-admins/recovery-codes` (replaceSuperAdminRecoveryCodes): Replace your recovery codes
- `POST /v1/super-admins/{user_id}/recovery-confirmations` (confirmSuperAdminRecovery): Confirm the other Super admin's recovery
- `POST /v1/supplier-refunds` (recordSupplierRefund): Record a refund from a supplier
- `GET /v1/supplier-refunds/{refund_id}` (getSupplierRefund): Get a refund from a supplier
- `POST /v1/supplier-refunds/{refund_id}/void` (voidSupplierRefund): Void a refund from a supplier
- `POST /v1/supplier-refunds/{refund_id}/void-approval` (requestSupplierRefundVoid): Ask for approval to void a refund from a supplier
- `GET /v1/team-mode` (getTeamMode): Get the team mode
- `PATCH /v1/team-mode` (switchTeamMode): Ask to switch the team mode
- `GET /v1/write-offs` (listWriteOffs): List the write-offs
- `POST /v1/write-offs` (createWriteOff): Save a draft write-off
- `GET /v1/write-offs/{write_off_id}` (getWriteOff): Get a write-off
- `PUT /v1/write-offs/{write_off_id}` (replaceWriteOff): Change a draft write-off
- `POST /v1/write-offs/{write_off_id}/post-approval` (requestWriteOffPost): Ask for approval to post a write-off
- `POST /v1/write-offs/{write_off_id}/void` (voidWriteOff): Void a write-off
- `POST /v1/write-offs/{write_off_id}/void-approval` (requestWriteOffVoid): Ask for approval to void a write-off
